The applied effect cannot be identical to the last effect applied, and will replace the previous effect. The applied effect will be removed when the wearer has been knocked down. Effects of the same type cannot be stacked. |effect_path = Harmony |eff_rank1_var1 = 10 |eff_rank1_var2 = 12 |eff_rank1_var3 = 6 |eff_rank2_var1 = 12.5 |eff_rank2_var2 = 15 |eff_rank2_var3 = 7.5 |eff_rank3_var1 = 15 |eff_rank3_var2 = 18 |eff_rank3_var3 = 9 |eff_rank4_var1 = 17.5 |eff_rank4_var2 = 21 |eff_rank4_var3 = 10.5 |eff_rank5_var1 = 20 |eff_rank5_var2 = 24 |eff_rank5_var3 = 12 |utility1 = ATK Increase |utility2 = CRIT DMG Increase |utility3 = Energy Regeneration Rate Increase }} '''Carve the Moon, Weave the Clouds''' is a 4-star [[Light Cone]] of the [[Harmony]] path. ==Description== {{Description|He immediately falls in love with the golden vessel and is about to buy it,
but the [[Tingyun|foxian girl]] drags him aside and whispers:
''"Please return at night, Mr. Benefactor, and make up your mind then."''

As promised, he returns at night.
The same foxian girl opens the door and smiles at him.
''"Please follow me, Mr. Benefactor."''

A ray of moonlight shines onto the base of the etched plate.
The artisan had traced the petals with lines of various depths, and he would not be able to see such details without the moonlight.

He finally recalls why this item is called "Carve the Moon, Weave the Clouds."}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|Carve the Moon, Weave the Clouds}} ==Availability== * [[Nameless Honor]]: Chosen from {{Item|Jewels of the Starry Seas}} after unlocking Nameless Glory or Nameless Medal and reaching level 30. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Carve the Moon, Weave the Clouds |zhs = 镂月裁云之意 |zht = 鏤月裁雲之意 |ja = 彫月裁雲の意 |ko = 누월재운의 뜻 |es = Esculpir la luna y tejer las nubes |fr = Nuages taillés dans la lune |ru = Вырезать луну и кроить облака |th = Carve the Moon, Weave the Clouds |vi = Khắc Lên Ánh Trăng |de = Den Mond schnitzen, die Wolken weben |id = Carve the Moon, Weave the Clouds |pt = Esculpindo a Lua, Tecendo as Nuvens }} ==Change History== {{Change History|0.90}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[de:Den Mond schnitzen, die Wolken weben]] [[es:Esculpir la luna y tejer las nubes]] [[fr:Nuages taillés dans la lune]] [[ru:Вырезать луну и кроить облака]] [[vi:Khắc Lên Ánh Trăng]]

You have the nerve to ask a question like that... is something wrong with the [[Silver Wolf|new recruit]]?
No.

...''}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|Before the Tutorial Mission Starts}} ==Gallery== Light Cone Preview Before the Tutorial Mission Starts.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/1909308 Light Cone Preview] Before the Tutorial Mission Starts — Fleeting Glimmer ==Availability== * Limited reward from the [[Starhunt Game]] Event. * Superimposition requires {{Item|Lil' Twisty Bubble Gum}} instead of an identical Light Cone. ===Sold By=== {{Shop Availability}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Before the Tutorial Mission Starts |zhs = 新手任务开始前 |zht = 新手任務開始前 |ja = {{Rubi|初|はじ}}めてのクエストの{{Rubi|前|まえ}}に |ko = 초보자 임무 시작 전 |es = Antes de que comience la misión del tutorial |fr = Avant que le tutoriel ne commence |ru = Перед началом тренировочной миссии |th = Before the Tutorial Mission Starts |vi = Trước Khi Bắt Đầu Nhiệm Vụ Tân Thủ |de = Bevor das Tutorial beginnt |id = Before the Tutorial Mission Starts |pt = Antes do Início da Missão do Tutorial }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.1}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[de:Bevor das Tutorial beginnt]] [[es:Antes de que comience la misión del tutorial]] [[fr:Avant que la mission du tutoriel commence]] [[ru:Перед началом тренировочной миссии]] [[vi:Trước Khi Bắt Đầu Nhiệm Vụ Tân Thủ]]

Dragon's Call can be stacked up to 2 times. |effect_path = Destruction |eff_rank1_var1 = 18 |eff_rank1_var2 = 18 |eff_rank1_var3 = 6.0 |eff_rank2_var1 = 21 |eff_rank2_var2 = 21 |eff_rank2_var3 = 7.0 |eff_rank3_var1 = 24 |eff_rank3_var2 = 24 |eff_rank3_var3 = 8.0 |eff_rank4_var1 = 27 |eff_rank4_var2 = 27 |eff_rank4_var3 = 9.0 |eff_rank5_var1 = 30 |eff_rank5_var2 = 30 |eff_rank5_var3 = 10.0 |utility1 = CRIT Rate Increase |utility2 = Basic ATK |utility3 = ATK Increase |utility4 = Energy Regeneration Rate Increase }} '''Brighter Than the Sun''' is a 5-star [[Light Cone]] of the [[Destruction]] path. ==Description== {{Description|From birth, all that ever lay before [[Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae|him]] was but a [[The Shackling Prison|lightless dungeon]].
To this darkness, irrelevant sins bound him... irrelevant memories engulfed him.
He writhed, gasping for breath with every fiber of his being,
attempting to clasp a sliver of light in this fathomless ocean.

Until the day the [[Jing Yuan|general]] stepped into the lightless depths of this prison,
he beheld a radiance shining brighter than the sun — the gaze of a young man.}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|Brighter Than the Sun}} ==Gallery== Light Cone Preview Brighter Than the Sun.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/21173576 Light Cone Preview] Brighter Than the Sun — Fleeting Glimmer ==Availability== ===Event Warps=== {{Featured}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Brighter Than the Sun |zhs = 比阳光更明亮的 |zht = 比陽光更明亮的 |ja = 陽光より輝くもの |ko = 태양보다 밝게 빛나는 것 |es = Más brillante que el sol |fr = Plus brillant que le soleil |ru = Ярче солнца |th = Brighter Than the Sun |vi = Rực Rỡ Hơn Mặt Trời |de = Heller als die Sonne |id = Brighter Than the Sun |pt = Mais Claro do que o Sol }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.3}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[de:Heller als die Sonne]] [[es:Más brillante que el sol]] [[fr:Plus brillant que le soleil]] [[ru:Ярче солнца]] [[th:Brighter Than the Sun]] [[vi:Rực Rỡ Hơn Mặt Trời]]

{{Light Cone Infobox |id = 23018 |image = Light Cone An Instant Before A Gaze.png|Light Cone Light Cone An Instant Before A Gaze Artwork.png|Full Artwork Light Cone An Instant Before A Gaze Icon.png|Icon |rarity = 5 |characters = Argenti; Idrila |passive = A Knight's Pilgrimage |effect = Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by {{Color|h|(var1)%}}. When the wearer uses Ultimate, increases DMG dealt by the wearer's Ultimate based on their Max Energy. Each point of Energy increases DMG dealt by Ultimate by {{Color|h|(var2)%}}. A max of 180 points of Energy will be taken into account for this. |effect_path = Erudition |eff_rank1_var1 = 36 |eff_rank1_var2 = 0.36 |eff_rank2_var1 = 42 |eff_rank2_var2 = 0.42 |eff_rank3_var1 = 48 |eff_rank3_var2 = 0.48 |eff_rank4_var1 = 54 |eff_rank4_var2 = 0.54 |eff_rank5_var1 = 60 |eff_rank5_var2 = 0.60 |utility1 = CRIT DMG Increase |utility2 = Ultimate |utility3 = DMG Boost }} '''An Instant Before A Gaze''' is a 5-star [[Light Cone]] of the [[Erudition]] path. ==Description== {{Description|[[Argenti|He]] once heard a ballad, singing in praise of that sliver of light:
Rose blooms, to answer [[Idrila|THEIR]] smile.
Dawn shines, to illuminate THEIR visage.
Melody plays, to banish THEIR fatigue.

But, light, once gone, never returns. Yet, he still gallops to the far beyond.
All that is needed is to wait for, to believe in, and to preach about everything that is of the [[Beauty]] in this cosmos.
Even if everything is but a fleeting instant before a gaze, he has already found the answer he sought.}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|An Instant Before A Gaze}} ==Gallery== Light Cone Preview An Instant Before A Gaze.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/23346888 Light Cone Preview] An Instant Before A Gaze — Fleeting Glimmer ==Availability== ===Sold By=== {{Shop Availability}} ===Event Warps=== {{Featured}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = An Instant Before A Gaze |zhs = 片刻，留在眼底 |zht = 片刻，留在眼底 |ja = その一刻、目に焼き付けて |ko = 눈에 담긴 순간 |es = Instante grabado a fuego |fr = Moment de grâce |ru = Остановись, мгновенье |th = An Instant Before A Gaze |vi = Khoảnh Khắc Nơi Đáy Mắt |de = Ein unvergesslicher Augenblick |id = An Instant Before A Gaze |pt = Um Instante Eternamente Adorado }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.5}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[de:Ein unvergesslicher Augenblick]] [[es:Instante grabado a fuego]] [[fr:Moment de grâce]] [[ru:Остановись, мгновенье]] [[th:An Instant Before A Gaze]] [[vi:Khoảnh Khắc Nơi Đáy Mắt]]

{{Light Cone Infobox |id = 23020 |image = Light Cone Baptism of Pure Thought.png|Light Cone Light Cone Baptism of Pure Thought Artwork.png|Full Artwork Light Cone Baptism of Pure Thought Icon.png|Icon |rarity = 5 |characters = Dr. Ratio |passive = Mental Training |effect = Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by {{Color|h|(var1)%}}. For every debuff on the enemy target, the wearer's CRIT DMG dealt against this target additionally increases by {{Color|h|(var2)%}}, stacking up to 3 times. When using Ultimate to attack the enemy target, the wearer receives the Disputation effect, which increases DMG dealt by {{Color|h|(var3)%}} and enables their follow-up attacks to ignore {{Color|h|(var4)%}} of the target's DEF. This effect lasts for 2 turns. |effect_path = The Hunt |eff_rank1_var1 = 20 |eff_rank1_var2 = 8 |eff_rank1_var3 = 36 |eff_rank1_var4 = 24 |eff_rank2_var1 = 23 |eff_rank2_var2 = 9 |eff_rank2_var3 = 42 |eff_rank2_var4 = 28 |eff_rank3_var1 = 26 |eff_rank3_var2 = 10 |eff_rank3_var3 = 48 |eff_rank3_var4 = 32 |eff_rank4_var1 = 29 |eff_rank4_var2 = 11 |eff_rank4_var3 = 54 |eff_rank4_var4 = 36 |eff_rank5_var1 = 32 |eff_rank5_var2 = 12 |eff_rank5_var3 = 60 |eff_rank5_var4 = 40 |utility1 = CRIT DMG Increase |utility2 = Ultimate |utility3 = DMG Boost |utility4 = Follow-Up Attack |utility5 = Enemy DEF Ignore }} '''Baptism of Pure Thought''' is a 5-star [[Light Cone]] of [[The Hunt]] path. ==Description== {{Description|The afternoon sunshine is just right, and the floral scents fill the air.
Though [[Dr. Ratio|he]] tries to keep his thoughts pure, cognitive stagnancy inevitably attracts particulates of mind like gathered dust.

''"Healing one's thoughts is just as vital as the maintenance of one's health."''
The fools' clamoring fades alongside fatigue as he sinks into the water, letting all thoughts loose, his mind elucidated and ordered.

''"Truth eludes all filths, accepting only those of pure thoughts."''}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|Baptism of Pure Thought}} ==Gameplay Notes== * If the wearer's [[Ultimate]] is used in their turn, the duration of Disputation will ''not'' decrease at the end of their turn. ==Gallery== Light Cone Preview Baptism of Pure Thought.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/24319428 Light Cone Preview] Baptism of Pure Thought — Fleeting Glimmer ==Availability== {{Featured}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Baptism of Pure Thought |zhs = 纯粹思维的洗礼 |zht = 純粹思維的洗禮 |ja = 純粋なる思惟の洗礼 |ko = 순수 사유의 세례 |es = El bautismo del pensamiento puro |fr = Baptême de pure réflexion |ru = Крещение чистой мысли |th = Baptism of Pure Thought |vi = Lễ Rửa Tội Thuần Khiết |de = Taufe des reinen Denkens |id = Baptism of Pure Thought |pt = O Batismo de Pensamento Puro }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.6}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[de:Taufe des reinen Denkens]] [[es:El bautismo del pensamiento puro]] [[fr:Baptême de pure réflexion]] [[ru:Крещение чистой мысли]] [[th:Baptism of Pure Thought]] [[vi:Lễ Rửa Tội Thuần Khiết]]

{{Light Cone Infobox |id = 23021 |image = Light Cone Earthly Escapade.png|Light Cone Light Cone Earthly Escapade Artwork.png|Full Artwork Light Cone Earthly Escapade Icon.png|Icon |rarity = 5 |characters = Sparkle |passive = Capriciousness |effect = Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by {{Color|h|(var1)%}}. At the start of the battle, the wearer gains Mask, lasting for 3 turn(s). While the wearer has Mask, the wearer's allies have their CRIT Rate increased by {{Color|h|(var2)%}} and their CRIT DMG increased by {{Color|h|(var3)%}}. For every 1 Skill Point the wearer recovers (including Skill Points that exceed the limit), they gain 1 stack of Radiant Flame. And when the wearer has 4 stacks of Radiant Flame, all the stacks are removed, and they gain Mask, lasting for 4 turn(s). |effect_path = Harmony |eff_rank1_var1 = 32 |eff_rank1_var2 = 10 |eff_rank1_var3 = 28 |eff_rank2_var1 = 39 |eff_rank2_var2 = 11 |eff_rank2_var3 = 35 |eff_rank3_var1 = 46 |eff_rank3_var2 = 12 |eff_rank3_var3 = 42 |eff_rank4_var1 = 53 |eff_rank4_var2 = 13 |eff_rank4_var3 = 49 |eff_rank5_var1 = 60 |eff_rank5_var2 = 14 |eff_rank5_var3 = 56 |utility1 = CRIT DMG Increase |utility2 = CRIT Rate Increase }} '''Earthly Escapade''' is a 5-star [[Light Cone]] of the [[Harmony]] path. ==Description== {{Description|Just as fireworks can flicker, [[Sparkle|she]] too can shift between ten different colors in a minute.

When the light show nears its end, she sits high above, regarding the bustling masses beneath her feet with boredom.
Thoughts flow and vanish, and slyness circulates across myriad eyes like a dancing kaleidoscope.
''"I've made my decision. This is how we're going to have fun today!"''

Bouncing and hopping, she glides through the crowds, her golden-red tail flitting in and out of sight.
''"Keep up! He stepped over the thorns that blocked the road and listened to the calls of humanity. He experienced anguish, through which he obtained tranquility.

''"Falling was originally just another name for flying."''
And on this eighth day, he granted himself "departure."}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|A Grounded Ascent}} ==Gallery== Light Cone Preview A Grounded Ascent.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/35213851 Light Cone Preview] A Grounded Ascent — Fleeting Glimmer ==Availability== {{Featured}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = A Grounded Ascent |zhs = 回到大地的飞行 |zht = 回到大地的飛行 |ja = {{Rubi|大地|だいち}}より{{Rubi|天|てん}}を{{Rubi|目指|めざ}}して |ko = 대지로 돌아온 비행 |es = De vuelta a la tierra |fr = Ascension terrestre |ru = Приземлённый полёт |th = A Grounded Ascent |vi = Chuyến Bay Trở Về Mặt Đất |de = Flug zurück zur Erde |id = A Grounded Ascent |pt = Uma Ascensão Aterrada }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.7}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[de:Flug zurück zur Erde]] [[es:De vuelta a la tierra]] [[fr:Ascension terrestre]] [[ru:Приземлённый полёт]] [[vi:Chuyến Bay Trở Về Mặt Đất]] [[zh:回到大地的飞行]]

''"[[w:c:typemoon:Caliburn|This sword]] wasn't hard to pull out at all, [[w:c:typemoon:Merlin|Merlin]]."''
''"Indeed. Becoming the king everyone wishes for won't be hard for you at all, given that I'm guiding you. However, Altria... The hard part is that you can't always meet everyone's expectations."''
''"Then they can choose a more fitting king by that time. I won't protest."''
''"But what if such a person will never exist?"''
''"...Then I'll do my best to meet everyone's expectations."''

Now, the girl had long since become aware of how profound that tragedy would be. Would she have chosen to give up if she were to return to that moment where everything began?

''"What would my future look like..."''
Dreams grow wings in his mind and fly towards the ends of the sky.
Ears of wheat dance in the wind and form ripples, as if responding to his boyish and earnest wish.

''"Even if I only have a single sword in my hand, I want to protect this place no matter what!"''
The youth made this silent vow in his mind —

A vow as deep as a brand, eternally etched into his heart.}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|A Dream Scented in Wheat}} ==Gallery== Light Cone Preview A Dream Scented in Wheat.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/39649112 Light Cone Preview] ==Availability== * [[Nameless Honor]]: Chosen from {{Item|Jewels of the Starry Seas}} after unlocking Nameless Glory or Nameless Medal and reaching level 30. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = A Dream Scented in Wheat |zhs = 氤氲麦香的梦 |zht = 氤氳麥香的夢 |ja = {{Rubi|麦|むぎ}}の{{Rubi|香|かお}}り{{Rubi|漂|ただよ}}う{{Rubi|夢|ゆめ}} |ko = 밀 내음이 가득한 꿈 |es = Sueños de trigo fragante |fr = Rêve au parfum de blé |ru = Пшеничные мечты |th = A Dream Scented in Wheat |vi = Giấc Mơ Vấn Vương Hương Lúa |de = Träume von duftendem Weizen |id = A Dream Scented in Wheat |pt = Um Sonho Perfumado de Trigo }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.4}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[fr:Rêve au parfum de blé]] [[ru:Пшеничные мечты]] [[vi:Giấc Mơ Vấn Vương Hương Lúa]] [[zh:氤氲麦香的梦]]

Tentacles extend from the [[Sea of Souls]], as if intending to toy with that [[Mydei|floating, fragile life]].
The broken limbs of the sea beast hammer giant sprays skyward, and sink into the oceanic abyss after shattering like rubble.

They say that the roar of the fight lasted for ten days and nights, overwhelming even the thunder and lightning.
They say that even if a man had ten thousand lives, he would not be enough to resist the Sea of Souls's erosion.

Then, courage washes away the immaturity and cold pride tempered timidity —

And that thin figure stumbled onto the shore. The first ray of the morning sun shines down upon the sea's waters, dyeing it like past blood.}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|A Trail of Bygone Blood}} ==Gallery== Light Cone Preview A Trail of Bygone Blood.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/39649112 Light Cone Preview] ==Availability== * [[Nameless Honor]]: Chosen from {{Item|Jewels of the Starry Seas}} after unlocking Nameless Glory or Nameless Medal and reaching level 30. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = A Trail of Bygone Blood |zhs = 一行往日的血 |zht = 一行往日的血 |ja = {{Rubi|古|いにしえ}}より{{Rubi|受|う}}け{{Rubi|継|つ}}がれる{{Rubi|血|ち}} |ko = 과거의 핏자국 |es = Sangre del pasado |fr = Trace de sang du passé |ru = Кровь прошлого |th = A Trail of Bygone Blood |vi = Vệt Máu Ngày Cũ |de = Blutzeichen aus der Vergangenheit |id = A Trail of Bygone Blood |pt = Um Rastro de Sangue do Passado }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.4}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[fr:Trace de sang du passé]] [[ru:Кровь прошлого]] [[vi:Vệt Máu Ngày Cũ]] [[es:Sangre del pasado]] [[zh:一行往日的血]]

She was once asked.

To some, she was the eminent "Imperator."
That cold and cruel tyrant, that ambitious "Flamebearer," that empress who burned the Old Era with blood and fire...

Others argued she was merely a pitiful "pawn."
This forsaken ruler was but a prisoner of ambition, destined to lose everything in that game of chess against the gods.

And some said that in the depths of her heart, darker than the ocean's abyss, she was just a mortal named "Cerydra."
One who mourned for fallen comrades, who hesitated and feared before her heavy fate, unable to move forward...

''"Heh. There is no need for history to remember me..."''

Swallowing the bitterness in her heart, she continued down that path of Flame-Chase paved with sacrifice.

''"It is our burning golden blood that shall engrave it!"''}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|Epoch Etched in Golden Blood}} ==Gallery== Light Cone Preview Epoch Etched in Golden Blood.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/40755741 Light Cone Preview] Epoch Etched in Golden Blood — Fleeting Glimmer ==Availability== {{Featured}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Epoch Etched in Golden Blood |zhs = 金血铭刻的时代 |zht = 金血銘刻的時代 |ja = {{Rubi|黄金|おうごん}}の{{Rubi|血|ち}}で{{Rubi|刻|きざ}}む{{Rubi|時代|じだい}} |ko = 황금 피가 새긴 시대 |es = Era grabada en sangre dorada |fr = Une ère gravée dans le sang doré |ru = Эпоха золотой крови |th = Epoch Etched in Golden Blood |vi = Thời Đại Máu Vàng Khắc Ghi |de = Zeitalter des goldenen Blutes |id = Epoch Etched in Golden Blood |pt = Era Gravada pelo Sangue Dourado }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.5}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[fr:Une ère gravée dans le sang doré]] [[ru:Эпоха золотой крови]] [[vi:Thời Đại Máu Vàng Khắc Ghi]] [[zh:金血铭刻的时代]]

''"Cute, playful, popular. Sparxie is everything I want to be..."''
''"Don't be fooled, Sparxie is a poison, she's a lie..."''

main.content:
{{Light Cone Infobox |id = 23060 |image = Light Cone A Star That Lights the Night.png|Light Cone Light Cone A Star That Lights the Night Artwork.png|Full Artwork Light Cone A Star That Lights the Night Icon.png|Icon |rarity = 5 |characters = Himeko • Nova |passive = First Wish |effect = The wearer ignores {{Color|h|(var1)%}} of the target's DEF when dealing DMG. When the wearer uses Assist Skill, they regenerate 6 Energy and gain "Sail," lasting for 2 turns and stacking up to 3 time(s). Each stack of "Sail" increases Assist Skill DMG by {{Color|h|(var2)%}}. When "Sail" reaches 3 stacks, each stack of "Sail" increases Ultimate DMG by {{Color|h|(var2)%}}. |effect_path = Erudition |eff_rank1_var1 = 32 |eff_rank1_var2 = 20 |eff_rank2_var1 = 36 |eff_rank2_var2 = 25 |eff_rank3_var1 = 40 |eff_rank3_var2 = 30 |eff_rank4_var1 = 44 |eff_rank4_var2 = 35 |eff_rank5_var1 = 48 |eff_rank5_var2 = 40 |utility1 = Enemy DEF Ignore |utility2 = Assist Skill |utility3 = Energy Generation |utility4 = DMG Boost |utility5 = Ultimate }} '''A Star That Lights the Night''' is a 5-star [[Light Cone]] for the path of [[Erudition]]. ==Description== {{Description|Looking back at [[Himeko|her]] childhood, she remembered the first time she heard adventure stories of the [[Trailblaze]].
Her tiny heart beat for the mystery and vastness of the universe, so she picked up a paintbrush and drew her very first imaginings of the cosmos.
''"A comet ship, a [[Star Rail|silver rail]], a Navigator..."''
''"With this, is it possible to Trailblaze now?"''

But a [[Weathering Curse|curse]] delayed her footsteps, and a sickbed confined her youth.
During those lonely times, towering stacks of books, scattered engine blueprints, and empty bottles of paint became her everyday life.
Her frail figure wielded the brush, carefully outlining the dream she yearned for.
''"Perhaps I can seize more possibilities within this limited time."''
''"Even a dream is worth being illuminated by colors."''

As the stars shifted once more, in the blink of an eye, she had already departed on her journey to the stars.
Carrying the wish she shared with her friend, she became the person she had always dreamed of becoming.

''"The journey of the Trailblaze begins at this very moment."''
The [[Astral Express|Express]] traverses the universe, and the footprints of the Navigator and her companions advancing side by side form a solid silver rail.
''"Together, let's reach the future where the stars reside!"''}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|A Star That Lights the Night}} ==Gallery== Light Cone Preview A Star That Lights the Night.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/45772220 Light Cone Preview] ==Availability== {{Featured}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = A Star That Lights the Night |zhs = 当一颗星照亮夜空 |zht = 當一顆星照亮夜空 |ja = {{Rubi|夜|よる}}を{{Rubi|照|て}}らす{{Rubi|導|みちび}}きの{{Rubi|星|ほし}} |ko = 별이 밤하늘을 밝힐 때 |es = Cuando una estrella ilumina la noche |fr = Une étoile illuminant la nuit |ru = Когда звезда озаряет ночное небо |th = A Star That Lights the Night |vi = Khi Một Vì Sao Chiếu Sáng Trời Đêm |de = Wenn ein Stern den Nachthimmel erhellt |id = A Star That Lights the Night |pt = Quando uma Estrela Ilumina o Céu Noturno }} ==Change History== {{Change History|4.4}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[fr:Une étoile illuminant la nuit]] [[ru:Когда звезда озаряет ночное небо]] [[vi:Khi Một Vì Sao Chiếu Sáng Trời Đêm]]

{{Light Cone Infobox |id = 21066 |image = Light Cone A Little Getaway.png|Light Cone Light Cone A Little Getaway Artwork.png|Full Artwork Light Cone A Little Getaway Icon.png|Icon |rarity = 4 |characters = Pearl; Topaz & Numby |passive = Whisper |effect = Increases the wearer's Elation by {{Color|h|(var1)%}}. During the use of Elation Skill by the wearer, ignores {{Color|h|(var2)%}} of the target's DEF. |effect_path = Elation |eff_rank1_var1 = 20 |eff_rank1_var2 = 8 |eff_rank2_var1 = 25 |eff_rank2_var2 = 10 |eff_rank3_var1 = 30 |eff_rank3_var2 = 12 |eff_rank4_var1 = 35 |eff_rank4_var2 = 14 |eff_rank5_var1 = 40 |eff_rank5_var2 = 16 |utility1 = Elation Increase |utility2 = Elation Skill |utility3 = Enemy DEF Ignore }} '''A Little Getaway''' is a 4-star [[Light Cone]] for the path of [[Elation]]. ==Description== {{Description|Night falls. Stars twinkle outside the window. The light casts two silhouettes on the wall.

''"Sensing: [[Numby]]'s Happiness Index: 97.9%."''
''"There's plenty of virtual currency here! Numby's bound to love it!"''
The [[Pearl|Intellitron girl]] strokes the pet's ears and takes out an ancient gold coin.

''"Numby, you can't eat this!"''
The pet leaps in joy, but she scoops it into her arms.
''"If I remember correctly, this is a collection piece used to restore history."''

The Intellitron girl smiles, recalling the long-obliterated civilization on that planet.
''"It matters not, [[Topaz & Numby|Jelena]]. The planet's historical prototype has entered the sketching phase. Progress: 85%."''
''"For now, let's just enjoy our vacation."''}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|A Little Getaway}} ==Availability== {{Featured}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = A Little Getaway |zhs = 放个短假 |zht = 放個小假 |ja = バカンスのひと時 |ko = 짧은 휴가 |es = Un breve dêscanso |fr = Une pause bien méritée |ru = Короткий отпуск |th = A Little Getaway |vi = Kỳ Nghỉ Ngắn Ngủi |de = Kleiner Kurzurlaub |id = A Little Getaway |pt = Um Breve Descanso }} ==Change History== {{Change History|4.5}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[ru:Короткий отпуск]] [[vi:Kỳ Nghỉ Ngắn Ngủi]]

When the wearer uses Elation Skill on all allies, increases DMG taken by all enemies by {{Color|h|(var2)%}}, lasting for 3 turn(s). Parameters adjusted."''
[[Pearl|She]] once tried to fit the curves of the sea into her artwork, extracting the form and spirit of water and analyzing the scattered specks of foam.
Time and again, countless waves bloomed from her brush, but none was the one she had imagined.

''"I wish to paint for all: not to trace their footsteps, but to illustrate their path forward."''
With a sweep of her brush, she brought shelter to famished children.
With a wash of ink, she mended the rifts between the sky and the earth with her strokes.
And her furthest stroke pierced the canvas of [[Planarcadia|this world]], extending into the vast cosmos.

For countless yesterdays, she painted the future for others...
The pale and the bleak, imbued with the color of hope.
Looking back, every stroke she laid down also shaped the "Pearl" within her heart.}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|Colors for Tomorrow}} ==Gallery== Light Cone Preview Colors for Tomorrow 1.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/46781937 Light Cone Preview] Light Cone Preview Colors for Tomorrow 2.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/46781937 Light Cone Preview] Light Cone Preview Colors for Tomorrow 3.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/46781937 Light Cone Preview] ==Availability== {{Featured}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Colors for Tomorrow |zhs = 献给明日的色彩 |zht = 獻給明日的色彩 |ja = {{Rubi|明日|あす}}に{{Rubi|捧|ささ}}げる{{Rubi|色|いろ}} |ko = 내일에 바치는 색채 |es = Colores para el mañana |fr = Couleurs dédiées au lendemain |ru = Цвета для завтрашнего дня |th = Colors for Tomorrow |vi = Sắc Màu Dành Tặng Cho Ngày Mai |de = Farben für morgen |id = Colors for Tomorrow |pt = Cores para o Amanhã }} ==Change History== {{Change History|4.6}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[ru:Цвета для завтрашнего дня]]

''"The experiment has ended. Time to take a break. I just can't miss this freshly made dessert."''

She saw the [[Herta|puppet girl]] frowning in deep thought.
''"Well, in your current body, you can only look but not eat. I'll make you a box of new ones when the time comes."''

{{Light Cone Infobox |id = 23014 |image = Light Cone I Shall Be My Own Sword.png|Light Cone Light Cone I Shall Be My Own Sword Artwork.png|Full Artwork Light Cone I Shall Be My Own Sword Icon.png|Icon |rarity = 5 |characters = Jingliu; Shard Sword (Weapon) |passive = With This Evening Jade |effect = Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by {{Color|h|(var1)%}}. When an ally (excluding the wearer) gets attacked or loses HP, the wearer gains 1 stack of Eclipse, up to a max of 3 stack(s). Each stack of Eclipse increases the DMG of the wearer's next attack by {{Color|h|(var2)%}}. When 3 stack(s) are reached, additionally enables that attack to ignore {{Color|h|(var3)%}} of the enemy's DEF. This effect will be removed after the wearer uses an attack. |effect_path = Destruction |eff_rank1_var1 = 20 |eff_rank1_var2 = 14.0 |eff_rank1_var3 = 12 |eff_rank2_var1 = 23 |eff_rank2_var2 = 16.5 |eff_rank2_var3 = 14 |eff_rank3_var1 = 26 |eff_rank3_var2 = 19.0 |eff_rank3_var3 = 16 |eff_rank4_var1 = 29 |eff_rank4_var2 = 21.5 |eff_rank4_var3 = 18 |eff_rank5_var1 = 32 |eff_rank5_var2 = 24.0 |eff_rank5_var3 = 20 |utility1 = CRIT DMG Increase |utility2 = DMG Boost |utility3 = Enemy DEF Ignore }} '''I Shall Be My Own Sword''' is a 5-star [[Light Cone]] of the [[Destruction]] path. ==Description== {{Description|The [[Shard Sword (Weapon)|blade]] shattered, plunging into the bone-chilling cold.
All earthly instruments are mere futilities, their worth discernible with a single glance.
''"What use do I have of swords?"''
[[Jingliu|She]] holds no attachment, nor does her gaze accommodate anything within.

''"From now on, I shall be my own sword."''
To transcend perceived precipices and achieve unprecedented breakthroughs,
one must regard themselves as "kindling" to fuel their own fire.}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|I Shall Be My Own Sword}} ==Gallery== Light Cone Preview I Shall Be My Own Sword.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/22162013 Light Cone Preview] I Shall Be My Own Sword — Fleeting Glimmer ==Availability== ===Event Warps=== {{Featured}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = I Shall Be My Own Sword |zhs = 此身为剑 |zht = 此身為劍 |ja = この身は剣なり |ko = 이 몸이 검이니 |es = Yo seré mi propia espada |fr = Ma propre épée, je serai |ru = Отныне я сама буду мечом |th = I Shall Be My Own Sword |vi = Thân Này Là Kiếm |de = Eins mit dem Schwert |id = I Shall Be My Own Sword |pt = Eu Serei Minha Própria Espada }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.4}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[de:Eins mit dem Schwert]] [[es:Yo seré mi propia espada]] [[fr:Ma propre épée, je serai]] [[ru:Отныне я сама буду мечом]] [[th:I Shall Be My Own Sword]] [[vi:Thân Này Là Kiếm]]

"[[Huohuo]], hurry up, or we won't wait for you!"
[[Guinaifen|She]] steps forward confidently with her phone clutched in her hand, seemingly unaffected by the paranormal ambiance.
"I—I'm over here!"
The girl standing ahead responds timidly.
"Huh? So you were in the front all along, then who is following [[Sushang|Shangshang]] and me..."

The perfect end for this scene would definitely be a girlish scream.}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|Hey, Over Here}} ==Availability== * Limited reward from the [[A Foxian Tale of the Haunted]] Event. * Superimposition requires {{Item|Exorcismal Fulu}} instead of an identical Light Cone. ===Sold By=== {{Shop Availability}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Hey, Over Here |zhs = 嘿，我在这儿 |zht = 嘿，我在這裡 |ja = よぉ、ここにいるぜ |ko = 저기, 나 여기 있어 |es = Ey, estoy aquí |fr = Hé, par ici ! |ru = Эй, я здесь |th = Hey, Over Here |vi = Hi, Tôi Ở Đây |de = Hey, ich bin hier |id = Hey, Over Here |pt = Ei, Estou Aqui }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.5}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[de:Hey, ich bin hier]] [[es:Ey, estoy aquí]] [[fr:Hé, par ici !]] [[ru:Эй, я здесь]] [[vi:Hi, Tôi Ở Đây]]

A sworn duty to defend home. A dream to blaze a trail across the world—
These were entrusted to the unworldly youth by [[The Watchmaker|a pair of rough, calloused hands]].

''"Soon, we'll be able to go to a larger world."''
The [[Misha|boy]] happily accepted his inheritance. Guarded by youth, he could not feel the weight born by the object's significance.

''"Of course. Before that time comes, however, guard this place well, Misha."''

{{Light Cone Infobox |id = 21038 |image = Light Cone Flames Afar.png|Light Cone Light Cone Flames Afar Artwork.png|Full Artwork Light Cone Flames Afar Icon.png|Icon |rarity = 4 |characters = Sam; Firefly; Terminus |passive = Deflagration |effect = When the wearer's cumulative HP loss during one attack exceeds 25% of their Max HP, or if the amount of their own HP consumed at one time is greater than 25% of their Max HP, immediately heals the wearer for 15% of their Max HP, and at the same time, increases the DMG they deal by {{Color|h|(var1)%}} for 2 turn(s). This effect can only be triggered once every 3 turn(s). |effect_path = Destruction |eff_rank1_var1 = 25 |eff_rank2_var1 = 31.25 |eff_rank3_var1 = 37.5 |eff_rank4_var1 = 43.75 |eff_rank5_var1 = 50 |utility1 = Healing |utility2 = DMG Boost }} '''Flames Afar''' is a 4-star [[Light Cone]] of the [[Destruction]] path. ==Description== {{Description|''"Package secured. I'll leave covering our retreat to you."''
[[SAM|Their]] comrade's voice comes through the communicator.

They glance around the surroundings, watching as the savaged remnants of their enemies continue to pass through the complex architecture inside the vast and abandoned structure.
They are drawing ever closer.
''"Please hold."''

After a beat of quietude, a series of apocalyptic explosions rocket up into the sky. Waves of displaced air casts clouds of dust high across the battlefield, and smoke scatter in all directions, the blinding white cleaving light into the night.
''"You know they purposely planted loads of gunpowder in there, right?"''

With a rustle, they flung open the cape as if they just finished a leisurely stroll.
''"Of course."
"So, let's light it up. All I need to do is play the part of the match."''}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|Flames Afar}} ==Availability== * {{Mission|A Walk Among the Tombstones|showChapter=0}} Mission Reward * [[Dr. Blues]]'s "Great Tree" in [[Origami Bird/Dreamflux Reef|Dreamflux Reef]]: "Find a total of 20 birds" Collection Reward * [[Echo of War]] ** {{Domain|Echo of War: Salutations of Ashen Dreams|withprefix=1}} ** {{Domain|Echo of War: Inner Beast's Battlefield|withprefix=1}} ** {{Domain|Echo of War: Glance of Twilight|withprefix=1}} ** {{Domain|Echo of War: Rusted Crypt of the Iron Carcass|withprefix=1}} ** {{Domain|Echo of War: The Comedy of Doom|withprefix=1}} ===Sold By=== {{Shop Availability}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Flames Afar |zhs = 在火的远处 |zht = 在火的遠處 |ja = 烈火の彼方 |ko = 불의 먼 곳에서 |es = Lejos del fuego |fr = Flammes lointaines |ru = Вдали от огня |th = Flames Afar |vi = Ở Nơi Xa Ngọn Lửa |de = Feuer in der Ferne |id = Flames Afar |pt = Chamas Distantes }} ==Change History== {{Change History|introduced=1.5|2.0}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[de:Feuer in der Ferne]] [[es:Lejos del fuego]] [[fr:Flammes lointaines]] [[ru:Вдали от огня]] [[th:Flames Afar]] [[vi:Ở Nơi Xa Ngọn Lửa]]

"And then what happens?"

"Mama, does that mean it becomes the 'future'?"

"Guess what it turns into after that?"

"It turns into so many flowers, blooming into a vibrant sea of blossoms, right?"''

The mother didn't have time to answer as the sunlight from the window warmed the [[Tribbie|girl]]'s face. That gentle figure vanished once more into her dream.
She opened her eyes—
''"If time were a flower..."'' she murmured.
''"It would surely become a sea of flowers,"'' said the [[Trinnon|serene girl]].
''"Of course it would!"'' Exclaimed the [[Trianne|playful girl]], cheering at her masterpiece.}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|If Time Were a Flower}} ==Gallery== Light Cone Preview If Time Were a Flower.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/37169667 Light Cone Preview] If Time Were a Flower — Fleeting Glimmer ==Availability== {{Featured}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = If Time Were a Flower |zhs = 如果时间是一朵花 |zht = 如果時間是一朵花 |ja = もしも{{Rubi|時|とき}}が{{Rubi|花|はな}}だったら |ko = 시간이 한 송이 꽃이라면 |es = Si el tiempo fuera una flor |fr = Si le temps était une fleur |ru = Если бы время было цветком |th = If Time Were a Flower |vi = Nếu Thời Gian Là Một Đóa Hoa |de = Wenn Zeit eine Blume wäre |id = If Time Were a Flower |pt = Se o Tempo Fosse Uma Flor }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.1}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[de:Wenn Zeit eine Blume wäre]] [[es:Si el tiempo fuera una flor]] [[fr:Si le temps était une fleur]] [[ru:Если бы время было цветком]] [[vi:Nếu Thời Gian Là Một Đóa Hoa]] [[zh:如果时间是一朵花]]

main.content:
{{Light Cone Infobox |id = 23039 |image = Light Cone Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path.png|Light Cone Light Cone Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path Artwork.png|Full Artwork Light Cone Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path Icon.png|Icon |rarity = 5 |characters = Mydei |passive = Vista |effect = Increases the wearer's Max HP by {{Color|h|(var1)%}} and Incoming Healing by {{Color|h|(var2)%}}. When using Skill or Ultimate, consumes HP equal to {{Color|h|(var3)%}} of the wearer's Max HP and increases the DMG dealt by this attack by {{Color|h|(var4)%}}. If this effect's consumed HP is greater than 500, the DMG additionally increases by {{Color|h|(var4)%}}.
If the current HP is not sufficient, this effect reduces the wearer's current HP down to 1. |effect_path = Destruction |eff_rank1_var1 = 18 |eff_rank1_var2 = 20 |eff_rank1_var3 = 6.0 |eff_rank1_var4 = 30 |eff_rank2_var1 = 21 |eff_rank2_var2 = 25 |eff_rank2_var3 = 6.5 |eff_rank2_var4 = 35 |eff_rank3_var1 = 24 |eff_rank3_var2 = 30 |eff_rank3_var3 = 7.0 |eff_rank3_var4 = 40 |eff_rank4_var1 = 27 |eff_rank4_var2 = 35 |eff_rank4_var3 = 7.5 |eff_rank4_var4 = 45 |eff_rank5_var1 = 30 |eff_rank5_var2 = 40 |eff_rank5_var3 = 8.0 |eff_rank5_var4 = 50 |utility1 = Max HP Increase |utility2 = Incoming Healing Boost |utility3 = Skill |utility4 = Ultimate |utility5 = HP Consumption |utility6 = DMG Boost }} '''Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path''' is a 5-star [[Light Cone]] for the path of [[Destruction]]. ==Description== {{Description|Cold dew congealed on the blade, sliding down in crimson streaks.
The rust-tainted wilderness still flickered with embers of battle, flames leaping upon the ashes.

"''[[Mydeimos]], that was a godlike fight just now!''"
A bare-chested warrior wiped his weapon clean, shouting in exhilaration.

"''Mydei, one day, I'll be as invincible as you!''"
A child gazed at him with reverence, clutching a broken sword in small hands.

"''Crown Prince, our return to [[Castrum Kremnos]] is within sight.''"
An aged man smiled, raising his cup in a toast to him.

He nodded silently and walked to the edge of the camp.
The pain of rebirth still coursed across his skin. Tomorrow, he would lead the Kremnoan detachment forth once again, migrating to foreign lands.
Where this wandering would end, he did not know. The only certainty was this — he would bear the duty of a king until the blood and flames consumed him.

As night deepened, he drank the bloodwine alone. A passing bard plucked at his strings, a wandering melody drifting through the air—
"''Home is the land of dreams, not a place one can ever reach.''" }} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path}} ==Gallery== Light Cone Preview Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/37576751 Light Cone Preview] Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path — Fleeting Glimmer ==Availability== {{Featured}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path |zhs = 血火啊，燃烧前路 |zht = 血火啊，燃燒前路 |ja = {{Rubi|前途|ぜんと}}{{Rubi|燃|も}}やす{{Rubi|血|ち}}の{{Rubi|如|ごと}}き{{Rubi|炎|ほのお}} |ko = 피의 불꽃이여, 앞길을 태워라 |es = Sangre y fuego, abran camino |fr = Flamme de sang, illumine mon chemin |ru = Огонь крови, воспламени мой путь |th = Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path |vi = Huyết Hỏa, Hãy Thiêu Đốt Con Đường Phía Trước |de = Flamme des Blutes, entzünde meinen Pfad |id = Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path |pt = Chamas de Sangue, Incendeiem o Meu Caminho }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.1}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[de:Flamme des Blutes, entzünde meinen Pfad]] [[es:Sangre y fuego, abran camino]] [[fr:Flamme de sang, illumine mon chemin]] [[ru:Огонь крови, воспламени мой путь]] [[vi:Huyết Hỏa, Hãy Thiêu Đốt Con Đường Phía Trước]] [[zh:血火啊，燃烧前路]]

When an enemy target gets attacked by the wearer, the wearer decreases the target's DEF by {{Color|h|(var2)%}}, lasting for 2 turn(s). The same types of effects cannot stack. |effect_path = Erudition |eff_rank1_var1 = 60 |eff_rank1_var2 = 12 |eff_rank2_var1 = 70 |eff_rank2_var2 = 15 |eff_rank3_var1 = 80 |eff_rank3_var2 = 18 |eff_rank4_var1 = 90 |eff_rank4_var2 = 21 |eff_rank5_var1 = 100 |eff_rank5_var2 = 24 |utility1 = Energy Generation |utility2 = DMG Boost |utility3 = Enemy DEF Reduction }} '''Life Should Be Cast to Flames''' is a 5-star [[Light Cone]] for the path of [[Erudition]]. ==Description== {{Description|In that hidden experiment, various illusions constantly surged forward, pulling at [[Anaxa|his]] steps.

The seductive whispers beckoned him to give up on that treacherous topic, for what reason was there to gamble his life?
The cold, threatening voice declared that those who walk the edge of life and death will ultimately burn their lives away.
Then there were the angry accusations, shouting to cast the blasphemer — the one who had desecrated the [[Titans|gods]] — into an execution grounds most cruel.

''"The performance of life, too, must eventually reach the curtain call."''

He closed his eyes, grasped the [[Coreflame|divine flame]], and let the pain drown his fading soul.
First, his resolute gaze. Then, his beating heart. The complete soul... He threw himself willingly into that most pure and intense flame to be used for the smelting—

The voices bubbled and then became silent.
In the darkness, the brilliant truth began to take shape in his hands.}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|Life Should Be Cast to Flames}} ==Gallery== Light Cone Preview Life Should Be Cast to Flames.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/38382839 Light Cone Preview] Life Should Be Cast to Flames — Fleeting Glimmer ==Availability== {{Featured}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Life Should Be Cast to Flames |zhs = 生命当付之一炬 |zht = 生命當付之一炬 |ja = {{Rubi|生命|せいめい}}、{{Rubi|焼滅|しょうめつ}}すべし |ko = 생명은 불태워야 하는 것 |es = La vida en llamas |fr = Une vie forgée dans les flammes |ru = Брошенная в пламя жизнь |th = Life Should Be Cast to Flames |vi = Sinh Mệnh Đáng Bị Thiêu Rụi |de = Das Leben sollte in Flammen aufgehen |id = Life Should Be Cast to Flames |pt = A Vida Forjada em Chamas }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.2}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[de:Das Leben sollte in Flammen aufgehen]] [[es:La vida en llamas]] [[fr:Une vie forgée dans les flammes]] [[ru:Брошенная в пламя жизнь]] [[vi:Sinh Mệnh Đáng Bị Thiêu Rụi]]

This effect can only trigger up to 1 time, and the trigger count resets every time the wearer uses Ultimate. |effect_path = Remembrance |eff_rank1_var1 = 30 |eff_rank1_var2 = 30 |eff_rank1_var3 = 12 |eff_rank2_var1 = 37 |eff_rank2_var2 = 35 |eff_rank2_var3 = 15 |eff_rank3_var1 = 45 |eff_rank3_var2 = 40 |eff_rank3_var3 = 18 |eff_rank4_var1 = 52 |eff_rank4_var2 = 45 |eff_rank4_var3 = 21 |eff_rank5_var1 = 60 |eff_rank5_var2 = 50 |eff_rank5_var3 = 24 |utility1 = Max HP Increase |utility2 = Enemy DEF Ignore |utility3 = Action Advancement |utility4 = Ultimate }} '''Make Farewells More Beautiful''' is a 5-star [[Light Cone]] for the path of [[Remembrance]]. ==Description== {{Description|Another farewell ceremony was underway.
[[Castorice|A young girl]], stepping on broken moonlight, wove a garland of parting by the riverbank. Ancient laments crystallized in the cold air, while the quiet river flowed into a distant land of blossoms.
Blood-stained scrolls, rusted long swords, handkerchiefs embroidered with poetry... She accepted their remains, along with the tales of their lives. ''"My eyes are like lenses, forever longing for the starry sky."''
—An epitaph dedicated to the [[Anaxa|departed scholar]].
''"For life and for death, the knight grants only a cold glance."''
—The maxim that the nameless warrior upheld all his life.
''"Life is nothing but death, aglow with shimmering light."''
—The final verse penned by the eternal-seeking poet with his life.
... ''"Every flower once bloomed with pride..."''
Accompanied by the river's soft lament, she offered the departed poems, garlands, and remembrances—
''"If withering is inevitable, at least let our farewell be... a little more beautiful."''}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|Make Farewells More Beautiful}} ==Gallery== Light Cone Preview Make Farewells More Beautiful.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/37997334 Light Cone Preview] Make Farewells More Beautiful — Fleeting Glimmer ==Availability== {{Featured}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Make Farewells More Beautiful |zhs = 让告别，更美一些 |zht = 讓告別，更美一點 |ja = {{Rubi|永訣|えいけつ}}よ{{Rubi|美|うつく}}しくあれ |ko = 이별이 더 아름답도록 |es = Despedidas más bellas |fr = Des adieux encore plus beaux |ru = Пусть прощание будет прекрасным |th = Make Farewells More Beautiful |vi = Để Lời Từ Biệt Đẹp Đẽ Hơn |de = Ein noch schönerer Abschied |id = Make Farewells More Beautiful |pt = O Adeus Mais Belo }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.2}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[de:Ein noch schönerer Abschied]] [[es:Despedidas más bellas]] [[fr:Des adieux encore plus beaux]] [[ru:Пусть прощание будет прекрасным]] [[vi:Để Lời Từ Biệt Đẹp Đẽ Hơn]]

The same types of effects cannot stack. |effect_path = Remembrance |eff_rank1_var1 = 18 |eff_rank1_var2 = 1.0 |eff_rank1_var3 = 250.0 |eff_rank1_var4 = 18.0 |eff_rank2_var1 = 21 |eff_rank2_var2 = 1.25 |eff_rank2_var3 = 312.5 |eff_rank2_var4 = 22.5 |eff_rank3_var1 = 24 |eff_rank3_var2 = 1.5 |eff_rank3_var3 = 375.0 |eff_rank3_var4 = 27.0 |eff_rank4_var1 = 27 |eff_rank4_var2 = 1.75 |eff_rank4_var3 = 437.5 |eff_rank4_var4 = 31.5 |eff_rank5_var1 = 30 |eff_rank5_var2 = 2.0 |eff_rank5_var3 = 500.0 |eff_rank5_var4 = 36.0 |utility1 = SPD Increase |utility2 = Basic ATK |utility3 = Skill |utility4 = Ultimate |utility5 = HP Consumption |utility6 = Additional DMG |utility7 = Enemy Vulnerability Increase }} '''Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky''' is a 5-star [[Light Cone]] for the path of [[Remembrance]]. ==Description== {{Description|''"Emotions are like clouds, and we are the sky that carries them. If the sky is overcast, then our emotions will fluctuate all over."''
[[Hyacine|The physician]] listens with care to the visitor's sorrows, offering words of gentle solace.
''"Please close your eyes and breathe slowly... Imagine yourself in a warm and soft place..."''

As if infused with magic, a seven-colored rainbow radiance spills from beneath the wings of the winged beast.
''"A breeze would drift across the plains, carrying the fragrance of wildflowers. Moist clouds would pass by, laden with sunlight..."''
The visitor gradually sinks into a peaceful dream, responding only with the quiet rhythm of steady breaths.

After seeing the last patient, the physician gently closes the door of the ward.

In the distance, the boundless evernight still surges, with many ruins standing like the scars of the earth.

''"In the next life, may dawn shine upon all..."''
Before departing, she makes a wish to the sky —
''"May the rainbow-colored light remains in the sky forever."''}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky}} ==Gallery== Light Cone Preview Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/38782026 Light Cone Preview] Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky — Fleeting Glimmer ==Availability== {{Featured}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky |zhs = 愿虹光永驻天空 |zht = 願虹光永駐天空 |ja = {{Rubi|空|そら}}の{{Rubi|虹|にじ}}が{{Rubi|消|き}}えぬように |ko = 무지개가 영원히 하늘에 머물길 |es = Que el arcoíris siempre esté en el cielo |fr = Éternels soient les arcs-en-ciel |ru = Пусть радуга сияет вечно |th = Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky |vi = Mong Cầu Vồng Mãi Ở Trên Bầu Trời |de = Mögen Regenbögen am Himmel bleiben |id = Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky |pt = Que o Arco-Íris Permaneça no Céu }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.3}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[de:Mögen Regenbögen am Himmel bleiben]] [[es:Que el arcoíris siempre esté en el cielo]] [[fr:Éternels soient les arcs-en-ciel]] [[ru:Пусть радуга сияет вечно]] [[vi:Mong Cầu Vồng Mãi Ở Trên Bầu Trời]] [[zh:愿虹光永驻天空]]

When "Bamboozle" or "Theft" is repeatedly inflicted, only the most recently inflicted instance takes effect. |effect_path = Nihility |eff_rank1_var1 = 18 |eff_rank1_var2 = 16 |eff_rank1_var3 = 8 |eff_rank2_var1 = 21 |eff_rank2_var2 = 18 |eff_rank2_var3 = 9 |eff_rank3_var1 = 24 |eff_rank3_var2 = 20 |eff_rank3_var3 = 10 |eff_rank4_var1 = 27 |eff_rank4_var2 = 22 |eff_rank4_var3 = 11 |eff_rank5_var1 = 30 |eff_rank5_var2 = 24 |eff_rank5_var3 = 12 |utility1 = SPD Increase |utility2 = Enemy DEF Reduction }} '''Lies Dance on the Breeze''' is a 5-star [[Light Cone]] for the path of [[Nihility]]. ==Description== {{Description|The [[Cipher|cat-eared girl]] stretches her limbs on the rooftop, slinking into the night.
In the treasure vault that had slumbered for a thousand years, she glides effortlessly, gathering precious treasures into her embrace before vanishing without a sound.
''"Foolish fate could never catch me!"'' The wind through the ruins carries the scent of the wild, rustling her hood.
Resting her head against the cold stone, she swallows a bite of rough, dry rations, idly tossing a gold coin between her fingers. A faint sound from afar reaches her ears. In that [[Okhema|holy city]] bathed in dawn's light, the bustling crowds still revel in warmth and celebration.
''"How much longer... a year, or ten thousand?"'' She stretches with a lazy yawn, casting her restless thoughts aside.
''"Hah, Cifera always has the last laugh!"'' A golden streak of lightning cuts across the sky, and her proclamation lingers in the wind—
Just as it had a thousand years ago.}} ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|Lies Dance on the Breeze}} ==Gallery== Light Cone Preview Lies Dance on the Breeze.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/ Light Cone Preview] Lies Dance on the Breeze — Fleeting Glimmer ==Availability== {{Featured}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Lies Dance on the Breeze |zhs = 谎言在风中飘扬 |zht = 謊言在風中飄揚 |ja = {{Rubi|風|かぜ}}に{{Rubi|揺蕩|たゆた}}う{{Rubi|虚言|きょげん}} |ko = 바람에 흩날리는 거짓말 |es = Mentiras que vuelan en el viento |fr = Mensonges au gré du vent |ru = Летящая по ветру ложь |th = Lies Dance on the Breeze |vi = Lời Nói Dối Bay Trong Gió |de = Vom Winde verwehte Lügen |id = Lies Dance on the Breeze |pt = Mentiras Dançando ao Vento }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.3}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[de:Vom Winde verwehte Lügen]] [[es:Mentiras que vuelan en el viento]] [[fr:Mensonges au grès du vent]] [[ru:Летящая по ветру ложь]] [[vi:Lời Nói Dối Bay Trong Gió]] [[zh:谎言在风中飘扬]]

After the wearer attacks, there is a 100% base chance to inflict the attacked target with Vulnerability, increasing the DMG they receive by {{Color|h|(var2)%}} for 2 turn(s). Effects of the same type cannot stack. |effect_path = Nihility |eff_rank1_var1 = 16 |eff_rank1_var2 = 10.0 |eff_rank2_var1 = 20 |eff_rank2_var2 = 11.5 |eff_rank3_var1 = 24 |eff_rank3_var2 = 13.0 |eff_rank4_var1 = 28 |eff_rank4_var2 = 14.5 |eff_rank5_var1 = 32 |eff_rank5_var2 = 16.0 |utility1 = DMG Boost |utility2 = Enemy Vulnerability Increase }} '''Holiday Thermae Escapade''' is a 4-star [[Light Cone]] for the path of [[Nihility]]. ==Description== {{Description|''"[[Hyacine|Cinny]], let's go try out that new special bath that recently opened."''

After finishing her medical duties in [[Okhema]], the girl followed the [[Tribbie|curious child]] into the eclectic set of pools.

''"How about a Tomato Juice Massage?"''
Staring at the attendant's crimson-stained hands, she hugged the eager [[Little Ica]] and retreated—
''"I prefer something... drinkable...."''

''"[[Dromas]] back massage, limited-time discount!"''
A curious dromas lowered its head, its hot breath tousling her hair.
''"N—Next time, maybe!"''

''"Herbal Bath — strengthens body and soul! How many in your party?"''
Lured by the fragrant herbs, she tentatively dipped a foot into the pool.
''"This... seems healthy..."''

''"Doot, doot-doot!"''
Little Ica floated blissfully on its back.
''"Guess even you needed a break from all we've been doing recently..."''

On this rare day off, sipping grape juice, the girl chatted with the red-haired child about everything from sleep tips to pastry recipes.

''"Oh no—Little Ica!"''
The child's shriek shattered the bathhouse's calm.

''"Doot..."
"Hold on, Little Ica!"''}} ==Gameplay Notes== * Vulnerability can be re-inflicted on an enemy already affected by Vulnerability, but the effect does not stack. ==Ascensions and Stats== {{Light Cone Ascensions and Stats|Holiday Thermae Escapade}} ==Gallery== Light Cone Preview Holiday Thermae Escapade.png|[https://www.hoyolab.com/article/39649112 Light Cone Preview] ==Availability== * [[Nameless Honor]]: Chosen from {{Item|Jewels of the Starry Seas}} after unlocking Nameless Glory or Nameless Medal and reaching level 30. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Holiday Thermae Escapade |zhs = 假日浴场大冒险 |zht = 假日浴場大冒險 |ja = {{Rubi|休日|きゅうじつ}}のバルネア{{Rubi|大冒険|だいぼうけん}} |ko = 휴일의 목욕탕 대모험 |es = Vacaciones en las termas |fr = Virée festive aux thermes |ru = Приключения в купальне |th = Holiday Thermae Escapade |vi = Kỳ Nghỉ Phiêu Lưu Nhà Tắm Hơi |de = Abenteuer der Urlaubsbäder |id = Holiday Thermae Escapade |pt = Fuga Termal de Férias }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.4}} ==Navigation== {{Light Cone Navbox}} [[fr:Virée festive aux thermes]] [[ru:Приключения в купальне]] [[vi:Kỳ Nghỉ Phiêu Lưu Nhà Tắm Hơi]] [[zh:假日浴场大冒险]]

This one can go to that unlucky brat. It'll shut her money-owing parents up, and maybe they'll hit her less."
"This can go to the granny selling pickle candies to help her out in a pitch. She really needs to see a doctor for all her pains. I don't wanna see a day when I can't buy such tasty candies anymore..."''

Bent over the rucksack, the girl meticulously counts the jewels in there, and suddenly sneezes.

"Ensnared" enemies' DEF decreases by {{Color|h|(var2)%}} for 1 turn(s). |effect_path = Nihility |eff_rank1_var1 = 60 |eff_rank1_var2 = 12 |eff_rank2_var1 = 70 |eff_rank2_var2 = 13 |eff_rank3_var1 = 80 |eff_rank3_var2 = 14 |eff_rank4_var1 = 90 |eff_rank4_var2 = 15 |eff_rank5_var1 = 100 |eff_rank5_var2 = 16 |utility1 = Enemy DEF Reduction }} '''Resolution Shines As Pearls of Sweat''' is a 4-star [[Light Cone]] of the [[Nihility]] path. ==Description== {{Description|The limelight cast on the [[Fight Club|boxing ring]] is bright, but no brighter than all those beads of sweat running down [[Luka|his]] back.

The ocean of [[memoria]] roars with mountainous waves and [[Firefly|she]], like a singular tiny spark, may be doused at any moment in the storm.
''"For one who cannot dream to enter the Synesthesia [[Dreamscape]], they would have to pay a price comparable to death."''
She can still hear her companions' concerned voices next to her ears. She takes a deep breath and dives into the Memory Zone.
As the vessel silently sinks into the depth of the Memory Zone, small pinpricks of firefly lights dissipate from the cracks and are then immediately swallowed up by the endless darkness.
''"Wherefore do you hurtle unto death?"''
In the ocean of memoria that grows deeper and deeper, the weak light emitted by the Memory Zone creatures are like faraway eyes that nonchalantly glance at her.

Dreams remained too distant for her. She gazes emptily out at the boundless darkness, her body and soul having reached the breakdown threshold long ago under the heavy pressure of memoria. Though she realizes her consciousness is gradually fading, only those remaining memories are playing over and over in her brain —
[[The Swarm]] that covered the sky tore through the frontline defenses as she flew towards the Swarm while enveloped in fire. The charred ash of the Swarm faded like snow, under which lies the pitch-black carcasses of the [[Iron Cavalry|knights]].
She didn't even have the time to take a bouquet and offer her final acknowledgement to knights, who were dying one after another. Their lives bloomed in the blink of an eye and went out equally fleetingly. Like a string of genetic code, they never possessed names and only had numbers allotted instead.

''"Wherefore do you live?"''
In the deathly silence, like flames dissolving in the sea, she is reduced to a singular spot of fire and unendingly progresses towards the light...
She opens her eyes after what seems to be forever. She sees the "future" looking like a pearl, radiating with a soft and vague light. Tears stream down her face —
